name: Princess suite — coordinated interior views
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. One consistent furnished room viewed in four labelled directions: arrival/front, opposite/rear, side and ceiling/section. Same wall/window/door arrangement and furnishings across views. Show the ceiling structure, circulation and source-compatible celebration dressing. This is ONE room reference, not four new objects. Full room shell bounds and a small top plan proposed; warm detail at human furniture scale, adequate path clearances. Title "INT-R02 — Princess suite — coordinated interior views". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".
